pages.speaker: Sign
pages.text: Welcome to Mosswick — the little town where moss keeps time.

pages.speaker: Sign
pages.text: Fernway Path. Wild creatures live in the tall grass. Carry Snare Orbs!

pages.speaker: Bram
pages.text: Mosswick sits right at the edge of the Fernway wilds.

pages.speaker: Bram
pages.text: Folk here befriend wild creatures instead of fencing them out. Odd? Maybe. Cozy? Definitely.

pages.speaker: Dr. Alder
pages.text: Ah, a new face! I study the wild creatures of Fernway Path.

pages.speaker: Dr. Alder
pages.text: Step into tall grass and you may meet one. Weaken it in battle, then throw a Snare Orb to befriend it.

pages.speaker: Dr. Alder
pages.text: Take these five Snare Orbs. Remember: your party holds three creatures at most.

pages.speaker: Dr. Alder
pages.text: Press M any time to check your party, use items, or record your progress.

pages.speaker: Dr. Alder
pages.text: Weaken a creature before you throw a Snare Orb. And rest at Ida's cottage when your team is tired.

pages.speaker: Keeper Ida
pages.text: Hello dear. Your creatures look a little weary.

pages_after.speaker: Keeper Ida
pages_after.text: There. Fresh as morning moss. Off you go!

pages_after.speaker: Keeper Ida
pages_after.text: Suit yourself, dear. The kettle stays warm.
